title: Order whose line items each carry a tag array of differing length
rationale: An array inside an array element is common (tags, serial numbers, applied promotions). The outer array survives, the inner does not: flattenObject serialises the inner list to a JSON string before the outer transposition sees it, and nothing ever re-parses it.
catchesBugClass: Single-level array expansion - the reconstructor unwraps exactly one array layer and leaves deeper ones as text. Also catches any future change that starts eagerly re-parsing string leaves.
cannotCatch: It cannot tell whether the failure is at flatten time or reconstruct time - both are true and it reports one result. It also cannot catch three-level array nesting, which routes through a different code path.

predicted.detail: Element identity and count are right; the tags type is wrong - inner arrays degrade to JSON text and one nesting level is lost.
